Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience using Excel to organize, analyze, and present data, including the use of formulas, functions, charts, and tables, and using PowerPoint to develop clear, professional presentations for a variety of audiences.

Provides comprehensive support and performs assigned activities for the effective operation of UCRH Administration. Manages complex calendars and makes scheduling decisions based on established priorities, commitments, and operational needs. Reviews meeting requests, identifies scheduling conflicts, recommends appropriate solutions, and coordinates necessary changes. Drafts, edits, prepares, and distributes correspondence, reports, presentations, briefing documents, agendas, and other executive materials. Researches and compiles background information and prepares leaders for meetings, events, and other engagements. Reviews incoming requests/correspondence, determines appropriate routing or action within established parameters, and completes or coordinates responses. Plans and executes meeting and event logistics (inc. facilities, technology, catering, visitors, travel, and materials). Prepares/processes travel arrangements, reimbursements, purchases, and other assigned transactions. Maintains executive office records and administrative documentation in accordance with organizational requirements and in compliance with federal/state requirements. Provides backup coverage and performs other administrative office functions necessary to maintain continuity of operations. Drafts and prepares professional communications, announcements, correspondence, instructions, and other materials for internal and external audiences. Responds to routine inquiries within the position's scope of responsibility. Develops and maintains administrative instructions, reference materials, templates, and process documentation. Participates in the development and revision of standard operating procedures and administrative guidelines. Exercises sound judgment, initiative, tact, discretion, and confidentiality while collaborating across UCR Health, campus departments, and external partners. May be assigned as Oracle Financial requestor, receiver and/or reconciler for depts. (25% time)

Administrative Analysis & Operational Support Performs administrative analysis and operational support for organizational priorities. Gathers, reviews, analyzes, and synthesizes operational, financial, administrative, and other information to support management decision-making. Researches administrative issues, identifies relevant policies, procedures, and background information, and develops findings with recommended next steps. Prepares reports, summaries, analyses, presentations, and other work products based on collected information. Investigates routine to moderately complex administrative discrepancies or service issues and works directly with appropriate leaders to resolve them. Serves as a resource to departments and stakeholders regarding assigned administrative processes and requirements. Applies established UC, UCR, and UCR Health policies and procedures within the scope of assigned responsibilities. (20% time)

Project & Program Administration Provides executive-level support for assigned projects, operational activities, and defined administrative programs from initiation through completion. Executes assigned projects and administrative initiatives, including developing work plans, coordinating activities, completing assigned deliverables, and supporting implementation. Researches issues, gathers required information, prepares documentation, coordinates stakeholder input, and completes administrative components necessary to advance projects. Maintains and tracks project documentation, including timelines, work plans, action logs, and supporting materials. Prepares draft status reports and communicates risks, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions to leadership. Implements approved process and operational changes within assigned areas. Develops, documents, implements, and maintains administrative workflows, procedures, tools, templates, and standard operating procedures. Provides administrative support for special initiatives and organizational priorities as assigned. (20% time)

Business Operations, Process Improvement, & Administrative Services Performs assigned business and administrative functions in accordance with university policies and procedures. Prepares, processes, and resolves assigned purchasing, reimbursement, travel, invoice, and other administrative transactions. Reviews transactions and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established requirements. Research discrepancies and works directly with appropriate campus or departmental resources to resolve issues. Coordinates vendor and supplier administrative matters within the scope of assigned responsibilities. Maintains appropriate supporting documentation and records. Supports office operations, including supplies, equipment, space, access, onboarding, and other administrative requirements. Serves as a resource for assigned administrative processes and assists stakeholders in navigating established requirements. Performs other administrative and operational duties necessary to support the leadership and administration suite. Conducts trends analyses and helps develop resulting recommendations. (15% time)

Additional assigned duties relevant to the operational needs for the leadership/administration suite. Serves as a key point of contact in UCRH administration providing timely and accurate information, coordinating requests, resolving routine issues, and facilitating communication with appropriate internal and external stakeholders. May share knowledge and information with others regarding established procedures, practices, and assigned areas of responsibility. (10% time)

Executive Meetings, Governance & Decision Support Provides substantive administrative support for executive leadership meetings, committees, workgroups, and governance activities. Develops draft agendas based on established priorities, previous discussions, pending decisions, and requested topics. Reviews and organizes supporting materials and identifies missing information or outstanding items prior to meetings. Researches and synthesizes relevant information and prepares briefing materials for leadership. Coordinates directly with presenters and stakeholders to obtain and finalize materials. Staffs assigned executive, committee, and workgroup meetings. Records key discussions, decisions, commitments, and action items and prepares professional meeting summaries. Completes administrative follow-up resulting from meetings and coordinates completion of actions requiring other departments. Researches unresolved matters arising from meetings and prepares information or recommended next steps for leadership consideration. Maintains governance records, decisions, supporting documentation, and historical materials. Supports implementation and communication of approved decisions and actions. (10% time)

Ability to compose correspondence that clearly and concisely provides information.
Working knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of academic and administrative structure of UCR.
Demonstrated ability to determine and locate relevant and reliable sources for the collection of information and data.
Skill and experience using office software applications, such as MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook to develop analytical summaries, reports, and correspondence.
Solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Demonstrated extensive and progressive experience providing project management and analytical support.
Ability to work with a diverse group at all levels of an organization including faculty, staff, students, senior administrators, and external constituents.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to organize and prioritize work and manage multiple priorities in a high volume, demanding environment.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to remain flexible with changing priorities and last minute changes.
Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
